gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-81.221948 35.663044)',4326) AS pt
),
patch AS (
  SELECT ST_Buffer(pt::geography, 100)::geometry AS g FROM origin
),
clipped_dem AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(ST_Clip(d.rast, p.g)) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us d
  JOIN patch p ON ST_Intersects(d.rast, p.g)
),
slope_rast AS (
  SELECT ST_Slope(rast, 1, '32BF', 'DEGREES', 111120) AS rast
  FROM clipped_dem
)
SELECT ST_Value(s.rast, 1, o.pt) AS slope_degrees
FROM slope_rast s, origin o;

WITH museum_point AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-81.221948, 35.663044), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
raster_clip AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Clip(
      r.rast, 
      1, 
      ST_Buffer(ST_Transform(m.geom, 4326)::geometry, 100), 
      TRUE
    ) AS clipped_rast
  FROM 
    public.dem_us r,
    museum_point m
  WHERE 
    ST_Intersects(
      r.rast, 
      ST_Transform(ST_Buffer(m.geom, 100), 4326)::geometry
    )
),
slope_raster AS (
  SELECT 
    ST_Slope(clipped_rast, 1, '32BF', TRUE) AS slope_rast
  FROM 
    raster_clip
)
SELECT 
  ROUND(ST_Statistics(slope_rast, 1).mean::numeric, 2) AS average_slope_degrees
FROM 
  slope_raster s;
